title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README to understand the project purpose, architecture, and setup. Golden Claw is a sanitized testing build of Get Sorted - a self-hosted personal AI OS dashboard.

title: Project Context and Structure
description: Read the project context to understand the key files, directory structure, and the role of the mission-control app within the larger framework.

title: Project Dependencies and Scripts
description: Examine the root package.json to see project-level dependencies, workspaces, and scripts that tie together the mission-control app and agents.

title: Next.js Application Root Layout
description: Navigate to the main Next.js entry point and root layout to understand the app initialization, global styling, providers, and overall page structure.

title: Landing Page and Initial Route
description: Explore the root landing page which introduces users to the dashboard and serves as the entry point before authentication.

title: Dashboard Layout and Navigation
description: Review the authenticated dashboard layout which wraps all protected pages with navigation, sidebars, and theme configuration. This is the main user interface structure.

title: Dashboard Home and Key Features
description: Examine the main dashboard home page and related key feature pages like mentorships, WhatsApp, and SEO. These demonstrate the primary workflows available to users.

title: API Routes and Backend Integration
description: Explore the API route structure under mission-control/app/api. These routes handle backend operations like mentorships, WhatsApp sync, cold outreach, and integration management.

title: React Hooks and Data Fetching
description: Review the custom React hooks that manage data fetching and state for major features like Descript, stock photos, X (Twitter), and Whoop integration.

title: Type Definitions and Data Contracts
description: Examine TypeScript type definitions for major domains: Descript, stock photos, X/Twitter, mentorships, and WhatsApp. These establish data contracts across the app.

title: Shared UI Components and Settings
description: Explore reusable UI components for settings panels, modals, and cards. Review settings sections for appearance, behavior, notifications, and system controls.

title: Database Schema and Task Runner Infrastructure
description: Dive into the agents/task-runner infrastructure which supports background tasks, database operations, and agent orchestration. This is the engine behind the dashboard.
